title: Apollo Client
description: A comprehensive GraphQL client with caching and state management.

data.text: Apollo Client is a powerful GraphQL client that manages both remote and local data. It provides a normalized cache, reactive queries, and built-in support for pagination, error handling, and dev tools.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
npm install @apollo/client graphql
# or
yarn add @apollo/client graphql

data.title: Basic Setup
data.content: Set up Apollo Client in a React app.

terms.definition: Apollo's normalized cache that stores query results for fast access.
A React context provider that makes the client available to the component tree.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Apollo Client provides a robust cache layer
Includes powerful dev tools for debugging
data.takeaway: Apollo Client is the go-to solution for complex GraphQL applications that need caching and state management.
